summary: Drive and anger flow with imagination and longing. This fluid pattern asks you to use courage and compassion with awareness.
body: Drive and anger flow with imagination and longing. This fluid pattern asks you to use courage and compassion with awareness. Charismatic motivation; action aligned with imagination. The pattern can flow easily, which is useful when it is conscious and easy to take for granted when it is not. In practice, this can show up through drive and anger, imagination and longing, and the choices you make when reactivity or confusion starts running the room.
gift: The gift is courage, compassion, and a more conscious way to work with drive and anger and imagination and longing.
shadow: The shadow is reactivity, confusion, and repeating the same pattern without noticing what it is trying to teach.
integration: Let drive and anger and imagination and longing cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Inspiring and persuasive; keep the aim concrete or the drive dissipates.
do: Name how drive and anger and imagination and longing are both involved
Turn courage and compassion into one concrete choice
dont: Ignore the needs of drive and anger or imagination and longing
